mapper.sql:
( SELECT ii.image_url FROM info_images ii WHERE ii.info_id = page.id
AND (ii.is_thumbnail = 1 OR ii.is_main = 1) ORDER BY CASE WHEN ii.is_thumbnail = 1 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END ASC, ii.order_index ASC, ii.id ASC
AND ii.is_main = 1 ORDER BY ii.order_index ASC, ii.id ASC
AND ( (page.content_type = 'FESTIVAL' AND (ii.is_thumbnail = 1 OR ii.is_main = 1)) OR (page.content_type != 'FESTIVAL' AND ii.is_main = 1) ) ORDER BY CASE WHEN page.content_type = 'FESTIVAL' AND ii.is_thumbnail = 1 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END ASC, ii.order_index ASC, ii.id ASC
LIMIT 1 ) AS thumbnail_url
